# 1 of 10

Acme onboarding

Get a new team live in five steps

# 2 of 10

Onboarding takes one afternoon

Three reasons new teams get to value fast with Acme Relay

One inbox

Requests, tasks and approvals land in one queue instead of four tools.

Fewer handoffs

Owners are set on import, so nothing waits for someone to claim it.

Clear status

Every project shows a live status line the whole team can read.

# 3 of 10

Five steps from sign-up to shared

Agenda

1 Setup: connect your workspace and SSO

2 Import: bring in projects from your old tool

3 Sync: keep calendars and tasks aligned

4 Review: check the import together, about 10 minutes

5 Share: invite the rest of the team

Before you start

An admin login

A CSV or export from your current tool

Thirty minutes with one teammate

Review in 10 minutes

Walk the checklist with one teammate: owners, due dates and anything flagged on import.

Pair the admin with one pilot lead for this step. The checklist covers owners, due dates and anything the import flagged. Most teams finish it in about 10 minutes, so book a short slot rather than a full meeting.

# 9 of 10

Tips

  - Start with one pilot team before inviting everyone
  - Clean up old projects before you import them
  - Assign an owner to every imported project
  - Turn on sync only after the review step
  - Keep the onboarding checklist pinned for new hires

# 10 of 10

Next steps for this week

Book kickoff

Pick a 30 minute slot with your admin and one pilot lead.

Connect SSO

Your identity admin turns on single sign-on for the workspace.

Import pilot

Bring in one team's projects and run the review checklist.

Invite team

Share the workspace with everyone once the pilot looks right.
